query.statement: SELECT DEFECT_CLASS_ID AS VALUE, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME AS TEXT FROM QMS_DEFECT_CLASS WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND (@severity IS NULL OR SEVERITY = @severity) ORDER BY DEFECT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SEVERITY, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_DEFECT_CLASS WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND (@severity IS NULL OR SEVERITY = @severity) ORDER BY DEFECT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT SPEC_ID AS VALUE, SPEC_NAME AS TEXT FROM QMS_INSPECTION_SPEC WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) ORDER BY SPEC_NAME

SELECT SPEC_ID, SPEC_NAME, PROCESS_ID, ITEM_NAME, MEASURE_TYPE, NOMINAL_VALUE, TOLERANCE_PLUS, TOLERANCE_MINUS, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_SPEC WHERE (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@measureType IS NULL OR MEASURE_TYPE = @measureType) ORDER BY SPEC_NAME

SELECT PARAM_ID, PARAM_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, MEAN, UCL, LCL, USL, LSL, SAMPLE_SIZE, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_SPC_PARAM WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) ORDER BY PARAM_NAME

SELECT DEFECT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_COUNT, DEFECT_RATE, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, IS_CONFIRMED FROM QMS_DEFECT WHERE (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY INSPECTED_AT DESC
SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, INSPECTION_TYPE, MEASURE_TYPE, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_ITEM WHERE (@inspectionType IS NULL OR INSPECTION_TYPE = @inspectionType) ORDER BY ITEM_NAME

SELECT INSP_DEF_ID, INSP_DEF_NAME, PROCESS_ID, PRODUCT_ID, INSPECTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_DEF WHERE (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@productId IS NULL OR PRODUCT_ID = @productId) ORDER BY INSP_DEF_NAME
SELECT METHOD_ID, METHOD_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, SAMPLING_TYPE, AQL_LEVEL, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INCOMING_INSP_METHOD WHERE (@productId IS NULL OR PRODUCT_ID = @productId) ORDER BY METHOD_NAME

SELECT GAUGE_ID, GAUGE_NAME, GAUGE_TYPE, MODEL, SERIAL_NO, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT_ID, CALIBRATION_CYCLE_DAYS, LAST_CALIBRATED_AT, NEXT_CALIBRATION_AT, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_GAUGE WHERE (@gaugeType IS NULL OR GAUGE_TYPE = @gaugeType) ORDER BY GAUGE_NAME

SELECT PLAN_ID, GAUGE_ID, PLAN_NAME, SCHEDULED_DATE, CYCLE_TYPE, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM QMS_GAUGE_CALIBRATION_PLAN WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT RESULT_ID, GAUGE_ID, PLAN_ID, CALIBRATED_AT, CALIBRATED_BY, RESULT, CERTIFICATE_NO, NEXT_DUE_AT, REMARK FROM QMS_GAUGE_CALIBRATION_RESULT WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) ORDER BY CALIBRATED_AT DESC

SELECT RNR_PLAN_ID, GAUGE_ID, PLAN_NAME, SCHEDULED_DATE, OPERATOR_COUNT, TRIAL_COUNT, PART_COUNT, STATUS FROM QMS_GAUGE_RNR_PLAN WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT RNR_RESULT_ID, RNR_PLAN_ID, GAUGE_ID, EVALUATED_AT, EVALUATED_BY, GAGE_RR_PERCENT, NDC, JUDGEMENT, REMARK FROM QMS_GAUGE_RNR_RESULT WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) ORDER BY EVALUATED_AT DESC
SELECT REPAIR_ID, GAUGE_ID, REPAIRED_AT, REPAIRED_BY, FAILURE_DESC, REPAIR_DESC, COST FROM QMS_GAUGE_REPAIR_RESULT WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) ORDER BY REPAIRED_AT DESC
SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, CATEGORY, MAX_SCORE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_SPM_EVAL_ITEM WHERE (@category IS NULL OR CATEGORY = @category) ORDER BY ITEM_NAME
SELECT DEF_ID, DEF_NAME, EVAL_CYCLE, TARGET_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_SPM_EVAL_DEF WHERE (@targetType IS NULL OR TARGET_TYPE = @targetType) ORDER BY DEF_NAME
SELECT PARAM_ID, DEF_ID, ITEM_ID, WEIGHT, SORT_ORDER FROM QMS_SPM_EVAL_PARAM WHERE (@defId IS NULL OR DEF_ID = @defId) ORDER BY DEF_ID, SORT_ORDER

SELECT RESULT_ID, SUPPLIER_ID, SUPPLIER_NAME, DEF_ID, EVAL_PERIOD, TOTAL_SCORE, GRADE, EVALUATED_AT, EVALUATOR_ID FROM QMS_SPM_EVAL_RESULT WHERE (@supplierId IS NULL OR SUPPLIER_ID = @supplierId) ORDER BY EVALUATED_AT DESC
SELECT ACTION_ID, RESULT_ID, SUPPLIER_ID, ACTION_DESC, ACTION_DATE, STATUS, COMPLETED_AT FROM QMS_SPM_ACTION_RESULT WHERE (@supplierId IS NULL OR SUPPLIER_ID = @supplierId) ORDER BY ACTION_DATE DESC

SELECT INSPECTION_ID, INSPECTION_TYPE, LOT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SPEC_ID, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, RESULT, SAMPLE_QTY, DEFECT_QTY, IS_CONFIRMED FROM QMS_INSPECTION WHERE (@inspectionType IS NULL OR INSPECTION_TYPE = @inspectionType) AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) ORDER BY INSPECTED_AT DESC

SELECT INSPECTION_ID, INSPECTION_TYPE, LOT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SPEC_ID, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, RESULT, SAMPLE_QTY, DEFECT_QTY, IS_CONFIRMED FROM QMS_INSPECTION WHERE INSPECTION_TYPE = 'Incoming' AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) ORDER BY INSPECTED_AT DESC

SELECT INSPECTION_ID, INSPECTION_TYPE, LOT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SPEC_ID, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, RESULT, SAMPLE_QTY, DEFECT_QTY, IS_CONFIRMED FROM QMS_INSPECTION WHERE INSPECTION_TYPE = 'Process' AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) ORDER BY INSPECTED_AT DESC

SELECT INSPECTION_ID, INSPECTION_TYPE, LOT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SPEC_ID, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, RESULT, SAMPLE_QTY, DEFECT_QTY, IS_CONFIRMED FROM QMS_INSPECTION WHERE INSPECTION_TYPE = 'Shipping' AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) ORDER BY INSPECTED_AT DESC

SELECT LT_INSP_ID, TARGET_TYPE, PRODUCT_ID, LOT_ID, WAREHOUSE, REQUEST_DATE, REQUESTED_BY, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, RESULT, STATUS FROM QMS_LONGTERM_INSPECTION WHERE TARGET_TYPE = 'Material' AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY REQUEST_DATE DESC

SELECT LT_INSP_ID, TARGET_TYPE, PRODUCT_ID, LOT_ID, WAREHOUSE, REQUEST_DATE, REQUESTED_BY, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, RESULT, STATUS FROM QMS_LONGTERM_INSPECTION WHERE TARGET_TYPE = 'Product' AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY REQUEST_DATE DESC

SELECT CLAIM_ID, CLAIM_NO, CUSTOMER_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, LOT_ID, CLAIM_TYPE, OCCURRED_DATE, SEVERITY, STATUS, ASSIGNEE_ID FROM QMS_CLAIM WHERE (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY OCCURRED_DATE DESC
SELECT NCR_ID, NCR_NO, SOURCE_TYPE, LOT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_ID, ISSUED_DATE, ISSUED_BY, DISPOSITION, STATUS FROM QMS_NCR WHERE (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY ISSUED_DATE DESC
SELECT HOLD_ID, LOT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, HOLD_TYPE, RISK_RANGE, REASON, REQUESTED_BY, REQUESTED_AT, STATUS FROM QMS_HOLD_RELEASE WHERE (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY REQUESTED_AT DESC

SELECT CHANGE_ID, CHANGE_NO, CHANGE_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CHANGE_DATE, APPROVAL_STATUS, REQUESTED_BY FROM QMS_4M_CHANGE WHERE (@changeType IS NULL OR CHANGE_TYPE = @changeType) ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC

INSERT INTO QMS_DEFECT_CLASS (DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SEVERITY, IS_ACTIVE, IS_DELETED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@defectClassId, @defectClassName, @description, @severity, 1, 0, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)
DELETE FROM QMS_DEFECT_CLASS WHERE DEFECT_CLASS_ID = @defectClassId
